title: CT 2: English Language (Fill In The Blanks - Vocabulary -1)

questions.text:
Directions: The sentence given below has 1 blank, the blank indicating that something has been omitted. Choose the word that would fit the blank appropriately.  

As the death count from a building collapse in Florida keeps rising, the relatives of missing people see their hopes ________.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Dwindling

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer:
    • Dwindling: gradually diminishing in size, amount, or strength
  • The sentence requires an adjective that can be used to describe the quality of the hopes people have about finding their relatives involved in the building collapse.
  • The sentence mentions that the death count from the incident is rising and this means that there are fewer and fewer chances of people being found alive.
  • News like this is bound to bring the hopes of the survivors's families down as they would not expect to find their loved ones alive. 


Thus, the correct answer is 'dwindling'. 

Additional Information

Let's look at the meaning of the other words:

Word Meaning
Submerging descend below the surface of an area of water
Swaying move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side
Peaking reach the highest point, either of a specified value or at a specified time
Awakening the act of awaking/ waking up from sleep

questions.text:
Two sentences are given below where one word can fill both the blanks. Fill in the blanks with the suitable word from the options.

1. The stern teacher warned her students against asking ________ questions and wasting her time. 

2. Michael's aim to dance until he wasn't worried about his problems seemed like a/an ________ idea.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Inane

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the answer:
    • Inane: silly; stupid
  • The first sentence talks about how a strict teacher gave her students a warning against asking certain types of questions. 
    • It is likely that the teacher asked them to not ask silly questions as they would waste the time of the teacher and the class. 
  • The second sentence talks about how Michael's had a plan to dance in order to worry less about his problems and this idea came off in a certain way. 
    • Unless the problem could be solved by dancing, it would seem stupid and/or silly to dance instead of trying to solve the problem. 


Hence, the correct answer is Inane

Additional Information

Let's look at the meanings of the other words:

Word Meaning
Vicious deliberately cruel or violent
Derogatory showing a critical or disrespectful attitude
Ingenious clever, original, and inventive
DIsingenuous not candid or sincere, typically by pretending that one knows less about something than one really does

 

  • While a question asked in class could be disrespectful, dancing to not worry about one's problems cannot be considered disrespectful. 
  • A question asked in class could be intelligent and dancing in order to worry less about one's problems could come off as smart, yet there is no teacher who would discourage students from asking smart questions.

questions.text:
Directions: The sentence given below has 1 blank, the blank indicating that something has been omitted. Choose the word that would fit the blank appropriately.  

After an ________ with staff members on board a plane, a passenger jumped off a taxing plane on a runway at a US airport.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Altercation

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the correct word:
    • Altercation:  a noisy argument or disagreement, especially in public
  • The sentence requires a noun that can be used to define the interaction the passenger had with the staff which led to him jumping off a moving plane. 
  • The blank is preceded by the article 'an', which is used for nouns that begin with a vowel sound i.e. a, e, i, o & u. Thus, the word in the blank has to start with one of these vowel sounds. 
  • Opening the door and jumping off a moving airplane is not an easy or safe task and thus is not something people usually do, it can be assumed that there was some serious reason why the person did what they did, some kind of a fight or an issue that they had. 


Thus, the correct answer is 'altercation'. 

Additional Information

Let's look at the meaning of the other words:

Word Meaning
Agreement harmony or accordance in opinion or feeling
Compliance the state or fact of according with or meeting rules or standards
Disagreement lack of consensus or approval
Squabble a noisy quarrel about something petty or trivial

questions.text:
Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Though monkeypox is caused by a virus that is _____ in a few African countries, the world took note only after it was first reported in the U.K. on May 6, 2022.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'endemic'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is talking about monkeypox which is caused by a virus that is found among people in a few African countries.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'endemic'.
  • The word 'endemic' means (a disease or condition) regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.
    • Example: In no time covid-19 turned into a pandemic from an endemic.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.

Additional Information

  Let us explore the other options:
  • contained: have or hold (someone or something) within.
  • limited: restricted in size, amount, or extent; few, small, or short.
  • restrained: kept under control.
  • suppressed: prevent the development, action, or expression of (a feeling, impulse, idea, etc.); restrain.

questions.text:
Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

There is nothing _______ about a Pakistani Prime Minister going out kicking and screaming having lost favor with the army.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'Novel.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is saying that there is nothing new about a Pakistani PrimeMinister losing favor with the army.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'Novel'.
  • Also, the use of the word ''nothing'' in the sentence indicates the use of the word 'novel' in the blank.
  • The word 'Novel' means New and different.
    • Example: The studio is looking for novel concepts to turn into original television series.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete Sentence: There is nothing novel about a Pakistani Prime Minister going out kicking and screaming having lost favor with the army.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • Ravel means To confuse or complicate a situation.
    • Hovel means A house or room that is not fit to live in because it is dirty or in very bad condition.
    • Revel means To get great pleasure from a situation or experience.
    • Dwell means To live in or at a specified place.

questions.text:
Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Perhaps the most _______ example of their broken word is the one given to Afghanistan’s young girls — female teenage students between Classes 6 and 12 are still not allowed to go to school
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'Egregious.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is talking about the outstandingly bad or shocking example of Afghanistan’s young girls not being allowed to go to school.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'Egregious'.
  • Also, the use of the phrase ''still not allowed'' in the sentence indicates the use of the word 'egregious' in the blank.
  • The word 'Egregious' means Outstandingly bad; shocking.
    • Example: It was an egregious error for a statesman to show such ignorance.
       

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: Perhaps the most egregious example of their broken word is the one given to Afghanistan’s young girls — female teenage students between Classes 6 and 12 are still not allowed to go to school.

Additional Information

  • Let us explore  the other options:
    • Religious means Relating to or believing in a religion.
    • Litigious means Tending or too ready to take legal action to settle disputes.
    • Ambiguous means Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
    • Envious means Wanting something that somebody else has.

questions.text:
Directions: ​There is a blank in the sentence given below. From the words given below, choose the words/word that fits into the blank most appropriately.

Global warming does not _____ storms but makes them more destructive.

A. beget

B. breed

C. restrict
questions.explanation:
The correct words to fill the blank are, beget and breed.

Key PointsNow let us look at the meaning of the correct words:

  • beget:
    cause; bring about
    . It is a verb.
  • breed:
    to be the cause of (a situation, action) It is a verb.

Here both ‘A' and 'B' aptly fit in the context of the sentence.

Thus the sentences are:

  • Global warming does not beget storms but makes them more destructive

  • Global warming does not breed storms but makes them more destructive

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words :
  • restrict:
    put a limit on; keep it under control.
  • destructive:
    causing great and irreparable damage.
  • storm:
    a violent disturbance of the atmosphere with strong winds and usually rain, thunder, lightning, or snow.

questions.text:
Directions: ​There is a blank in the sentence given below. From the words given below, choose the words/word that fits into the blank most appropriately.

The _______ diagnosis was skin cancer and after treatment, all seemed well.

A. ultimate

B. eventual

C. premier
questions.explanation:
The correct words to fill the blank are, ultimate and endmost.

Key PointsNow let us look at the meaning of the correct words:

  • ultimate: 
    being or happening at the end of a process; final
    . It is an adjective.
  • eventual: happening as a result at the end of a period of time or of a process. It is an adjective.

Here both ‘A' and 'B' aptly fit in the context of the sentence. 

Thus the sentences are:

  • The ultimate diagnosis was skin cancer and after treatment, all seemed well.

 

  • The eventual diagnosis was skin cancer and after treatment, all seemed well.​

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words :
  • premier: 
    first in importance, order, or position; leading.
  • diagnosis: 
    the identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

questions.text:
Directions: Choose the word for the given options that could fit in the blank correctly.

As society becomes more _______ in cash terms, time becomes more precious.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'affluent'

Key Points

  • Here in the blank, we need an adjective after the adverb 'more'.
  • Let's understand the meaning of options:
    • Affluent(adj) - Having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
    • Affluence(noun) - Abundant wealth
    • Wealth(noun) - The quality of profuse abundance
    • Cheerful(adj) - Being full of or promoting cheer;
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
​
The correct sentence is: As society becomes more affluent in cash terms, time becomes more precious.

questions.text:
Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
She watched him as he began to ___ the dark yellow drink and enjoy the evening.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'sip'.

Key Points

  •  The given sentence is talking about a woman watching a man drink a dark yellow drink.
  • Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'sip'.
  • The word 'sip' means  to drink (a liquid) a little at a time; take small tastes of
    • Example: He sipped the tea and enjoyed the view of the mountains
Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.
  • Let us explore the other options:
    • Abstain: restrain oneself from doing or enjoying something.
    • Refrain: stop oneself from doing something.
    • Forgo: go without (something desirable).
    • Withhold: refuse to give (something that is due to or is desired by another).
